name: Elbow Engine
description: Pump a passive-shoulder, powered-elbow brass acrobot above a visible height marker.
natural_language: Start the engine. Apply negative, neutral, or positive elbow torque to swing the glowing free tip above the green height marker. The ceiling hinge is passive. Submit the trial after crossing. Only use screenshots and visible task webpage controls; do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or hidden implementation state. Stay on the task tab; only tabs opened by visible task controls as part of the task may be used.

metadata.notes: Original planar acrobot with fixed-step physical replay. Candidate pending human and agent evidence.
